about: Britt Miller is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Chicago, Illinois area. Providing legal representation in Illinois for a variety of different issues, Britt Miller was selected to Super Lawyers for 2018 - 2027.

After completing undergraduate studies, Britt Miller attended law school. Britt Miller was enrolled at Northwestern University School of Law. She earned a juris doctor degree in 1998. Britt Miller was admitted to the practice of law in 1998.

Attorneys like Britt Miller are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Britt Miller represents clients with Antitrust Litigation issues. Additional legal issues represented include Civil Litigation: Defense.
